第14章进入前的准备
新书期数据很重要，看书的朋友记得收藏一下，最好还有推荐票，拜谢了。
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
华十二一边吃着炒饭，一边在网页的搜索栏里输入‘刘北山’和‘陈念’的名字。
虽然这两个名字他没听说过，但是系统已经说明，任务都是来自于蓝本世界平行空间，所以这俩人不难找，肯定不是小说就是影视剧里的人物。
果然随着回车键的敲下，一排排有关这两个名字的信息就展现在他眼前。
‘刘北山’和‘陈念’，这两个人物是电影‘少年的你’中的男女主角。
华十二也不看评价，直接在电脑上打开某电影网站，打算先看了剧情再说。
片头的时候，他去冰箱取了两罐啤酒，回来边吃喝，边看电影。
这是一部反应校园霸凌的现实题材电影，2011年高考前夕，女主陈念的同学胡小蝶因为遭遇霸凌而跳楼，面对前来调查的警察，陈念选择沉默以对，没有说出知道的事情。
因为生性懦弱的她只想着熬过高考前的最后两个月，然后就可以摆脱这一切去京城上大学，可她万万没想到，自己却成为了霸凌者新的目标。
一次偶然，陈念邂逅了男主，自称‘小北’的刘北山。
小北孤身一人混迹街头，以偷窃手机和替人收账为生，他答应陈念在暗中保护她免受霸凌，两个人在高考前短短的时间里，成为了彼此的那道光。
可惜，一次小北被抓入警局协助调查，就在这段时间里，一场意外，让陈念误杀了霸凌她的同学魏莱，这为两个人的未来蒙上了一层阴影。
电影的最后，陈念以过失致人死亡罪入狱四年，虽然出狱之后，小北依然保护着她，一如既往，但她却错过了一直渴望的大学生涯。
这部电影里有青春的美好，但更多的是面对霸凌的痛苦和无奈。
华十二看完之后，感触良多，霸凌这种事情虽然他上学的时候没有经历过，但却也亲眼看到过，这种事情绝不是个案，而是长久以来就有的校园问题。
对于这种事情，华十二不愿多做评论，他现在只有一个疑问，那就是刘北山希望给陈念一个完美的结局，那做到怎样，才算完美呢？
显然杀人坐牢肯定不算，但只让陈念摆脱牢狱之灾，顺利的去京城上了她理想中的大学，就算完美了么？
若是陈念毕业之后。没找到好工作，生活困顿，过的并不如意，那算不算完美？

如果不算的话，接了这单任务岂不是要照顾陈念一生一世？
华十二想了半天，觉得从电影里刘北山对陈念的态度来看，显然是有了感情的，也就是说，很有可能就是自己猜测的这样，完成任务怕不是需要几十年光景。
想到这么长时间，立刻就心生退意想要放弃，可又想到这是他第一个任务，心里又极为不甘。
“系统，任务世界与现实世界的时间比例是怎样的？不会是一比一吧？另外如果任务时间太长，我会不会在任务世界老去？”
华十二问出了这个他比较担心的的问题，否则以后若是进入什么仙侠世界，动不动就成百上千年，回来之后都沧海桑田了，那不是把自己玩儿了么。
好在系统的回复让他松了口气，在他完成试炼任务，成功与系统绑定那一刻起，当他再次进入任务世界的时候，系统会定位他进入时的时间节点，如此保证他回归的时候还是在这一刻。
也就是说无论他在任务世界耽搁多久，对于现实世界，都只是一瞬间。
最重要的是系统告诉他，在他完成任务返回现实世界的时候，系统会祛除他身上的负面状态，这样可以确保不会有平行空间中的负面因素被带到现实世界来。
系统如此做的目的，是防止病毒、或者灵体，通过宿主的身体来到现实世界，从而影响到本源宇宙。
所谓的负面状态，就包括受伤、衰老、以及心理、灵魂方面的因素。
所以华十二完全不用担心会在任务世界老去，或者因为在任务世界待的时间太长，而导致心理方面产生的负面变化，如性格改变之类的等等。
总之进去的时候什么样，出来的时候就是什么样。
当然也有不好的地方，如在任务世界得到了某种强化，在离开任务世界的时候，这种强化也会被系统祛除。
想要通过任务世界强化，只能靠完成任务之后的抽奖环节。
另外要注意的是，如果在任务世界死亡，那就真的死亡了，系统便会脱离宿主，寻找新的宿主。
华十二考虑了良久，还是决定接下任务，毕竟这是他第一个正式任务，怎么也要搏一个开门红，要是放弃的话，未免太不吉利了。
不过他并没有立刻接下任务，正所谓不打无把握之仗，反正有三天时间，他要利用这三天时间，好好准备一番。

Chapter 14 Preparation before entering
The new book issue data is very important. Friends who read books, remember to save it. It is best to have recommendation votes. Thank you.
※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※※
While eating fried rice, Hua Twelve entered the names of 'Liu Beishan' and 'Chen Nian' in the search bar of the web page.
Although he has never heard of these two names, the system has stated that the tasks come from the parallel space of the original world, so it is not difficult to find these two people. They must be characters in novels or movies and TV series.
Sure enough, as he pressed the Enter key, rows of information about these two names were displayed in front of him.
‘Liu Beishan’ and ‘Chen Nian’, these two characters are the male and female protagonists in the movie ‘Young You’.
Hua Twelve didn't read the reviews and directly opened a movie website on his computer, intending to read the plot first.
At the beginning of the film, he went to the refrigerator to get two cans of beer, and came back to eat and drink while watching the movie.
This is a realistic movie that reflects campus bullying. On the eve of the college entrance examination in 2011, the heroine Chen Nian’s classmate Hu Xiaodie jumped off a building because of being bullied. Facing the police who came to investigate, Chen Nian chose to remain silent and did not tell what he knew.
Because of her cowardly nature, she only wanted to get through the last two months before the college entrance examination, and then she could get away from it all and go to university in the capital. But she never expected that she would become the new target of bullies.
By chance, Chen Nian met the male protagonist, Liu Beishan, who called himself "Xiao Bei".
Xiaobei wandered the streets alone, making a living by stealing mobile phones and collecting bills for others. He promised Chen Nian to secretly protect her from bullying. In the short period of time before the college entrance examination, the two became each other's light.
Unfortunately, Xiaobei was taken into the police station to assist in the investigation. During this period, an accident caused Chen Nian to accidentally kill Wei Lai, the classmate who bullied her. This cast a shadow on the future of the two of them.
At the end of the movie, Chen Nian was imprisoned for four years for manslaughter causing death. Although after being released from prison, Xiaobei still protected her as always, but she missed the college career she had always longed for.
This movie contains the beauty of youth, but more importantly, it shows the pain and helplessness of facing bullying.
After Hua Twelve read it, he felt a lot. Although he had never experienced bullying when he was in school, he had seen it with his own eyes. This kind of thing was by no means an isolated case, but a long-standing campus problem.
Hua Twelve did not want to comment on this kind of thing. He only has one question now, that is, Liu Beishan hopes to give Chen Nian a perfect ending, so how can it be considered perfect?
Obviously killing someone and going to jail would definitely not count, but would it be perfect if it only allowed Chen Nian to get out of jail and successfully go to the capital of her dreams to attend her ideal university?
If Chen Nian graduates. If you haven't found a good job, your life is difficult, and your life is not satisfactory, is that considered perfect?
If not, wouldn't taking on this task mean that I have to take care of Chen Nian for the rest of his life?
Hua Twelve thought for a long time and felt that judging from Liu Beishan's attitude towards Chen Nian in the movie, it was obvious that he had feelings for Chen Nian. In other words, it was probably what he had guessed. It might not take decades to complete the task.
Thinking that it had taken so long, he immediately wanted to give up, but also thought that this was his first mission, and he felt extremely unwilling to do so.
"System, what is the time ratio between the mission world and the real world? It won't be one to one, right? Also, if the mission time is too long, will I grow old in the mission world?"
Hua Twelve asked this question that he was more worried about. Otherwise, if he enters some fairy world in the future, he will be gone for hundreds or even thousands of years, and the world will be changed after he comes back. Wouldn't he be playing with himself?
Fortunately, the system's reply made him relieved. From the moment he completed the trial mission and was successfully bound to the system, when he entered the mission world again,The system will locate the time node when he entered, so as to ensure that he returns at this moment.
In other words, no matter how long he stayed in the mission world, it was only a moment in the real world.
The most important thing is that the system told him that when he completes the task and returns to the real world, the system will remove the negative status on him, thus ensuring that no negative factors from the parallel space will be brought to the real world.
The purpose of the system is to prevent viruses or spirits from entering the real world through the host's body and thus affecting the original universe.
The so-called negative states include injuries, aging, and psychological and soul factors.
Therefore, Hua Twelve does not have to worry about aging in the mission world, or having negative psychological changes caused by staying in the mission world for too long, such as personality changes, etc.
In short, what it looks like when you go in is what it looks like when you come out.
Of course, there are also disadvantages. For example, if you receive some kind of enhancement in the mission world, this enhancement will also be removed by the system when you leave the mission world.
If you want to strengthen through the mission world, you can only rely on the lottery after completing the mission.
Another thing to note is that if you die in the mission world, you are really dead, and the system will break away from the host and find a new host.
After thinking about it for a long time, Hua Twelve decided to accept the mission. After all, this was his first official mission. He had to get off to a good start. It would be unlucky to give up.
However, he did not accept the task immediately. As the saying goes, don't fight an uncertain battle. There are three days anyway, and he will use these three days to prepare well.
